title: Link error when glTF module is disabled
body:
### Tested versions

4.5 branch [5b1bb7e3cbf96bcd2ff859d78e32478073ad9b78]
current master [f5918a9d35350bf6402dd1b4902ab539747d77a6]

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev (f5918a9d3) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 24 Nov 2025 15:21:09 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 580.105.08) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400F (16 threads) - 15.37 GiB memory

### Issue description

### Steps to reproduce

Try to build with the glTF module disabled and tests enabled:

```
scons tests=yes module_gltf_enabled=no
```
